responsibility: This file implements the AArch64-specific early RTL register-allocation pass `early_ra`, which tries to assign FP/SIMD hard registers before scheduling for selected pseudos when a spill-free allocation is possible. Using DF and `rtl-ssa` information, it analyzes regions with live FP-register pseudos, tracks per-register live ranges and operand constraints, exploits strided multi-register uses such as SME2 vector accesses, rewrites pseudos to hard FP/SIMD registers when safe, and leaves the remaining cases to the normal register allocator.
